# `ofac_snapshots`

**OFAC sanctions snapshots**

Publication metadata and reference dictionaries retained once per selected OFAC snapshot.

**Coverage.** Not a range. Every entity in each explicitly admitted selected export is retained. Selected SDN and consolidated exports need not share an update time. Prior selected snapshots remain on refresh; absence does not establish delisting, and no history before these captures is inferred. Qualification and public selection are recorded by the generation evidence. *(measured 2026-10-20)*

- **Parquet file:** `ofac_snapshots.parquet`
- **MCP `query_sql` support:** Configured; requires an available artifact.
- **Publication status:** Not established by this schema page or its measurement date.
- **Row count:** Not stated here; the MCP `describe_table` reply gives the live count under `publication`.

| Column | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `snapshot_id` | `VARCHAR` | Admitted source-release digest. Captures remain separate even when original content is unchanged. |
| `selected_list` | `VARCHAR` | Explicitly selected sdn or consolidated export; separate from the memberships stated by an entity. |
| `observed_at` | `VARCHAR` | Capture timestamp with explicit timezone, separate from publisher update time. |
| `data_as_of_raw` | `VARCHAR` | Literal publisher dataAsOf. A missing timezone is not invented; different lists can report different update dates. |
| `entity_count` | `BIGINT` | Number of distinct entity observations in this completely accepted selected snapshot. |
| `source_release_logical_id` | `VARCHAR` | Logical identity of the admitted source release. |
| `source_release_digest` | `VARCHAR` | Exact admitted source-release digest, also used as snapshot_id. |
| `source_selection_json` | `VARCHAR` | Selected export, original response digest and byte size, capture time and XML member name. |
| `raw_metadata_json` | `VARCHAR` | Ordered root, container, reference dictionaries, publication metadata and unknown nonentity observations, retained once per snapshot. |
